explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 63 named tracks, release cuts, reviews and catalogue references across Juno's live September 2026 techno window, official Bandcamp and distributor pages, COW and PS11 emerging hardware-led fields, Alex Wilcox's current vinyl-contextualized June digital release, adjacent label catalogues and overlooked acid, broken-beat and experimental-techno catalogue material. Written metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Runs 170–196 artist and release fields were not recycled. Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior unresolved titles, prior ranked leads, unselected alternates and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.

The immediately prior FAUZIA, 747, Boards of Canada, Night Format, BRNT and D.A.V.E. The Drummer field was excluded. Previously unresolved End Of Perception identities and the still-forthcoming Sa Pa September 14 release watch were also excluded.
The scan covered current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked or newly contextualized catalogue material. Nine exact-title leads survived without padding.
Every placement pair was re-derived from the current 52-track ledger and checked for adjacency. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer sequence remains untouched.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Juno's live September 2026 listings supplied exact tracklists and track-specific descriptions for COW, PS11 and Alex Wilcox. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno/this-week/

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: COW's official UMAY release and PS11's current limited Downside Up release supplied exact identities and emerging-artist context. https://umay.bandcamp.com/album/open-the-closed · https://www.juno.co.uk/products/ps11-stratos-ep-vinyl/1168229-01/

OVERLOOKED / NEWLY CONTEXTUALIZED WINDOW: Alex Wilcox's June digital release re-entered the current field through the September vinyl listing, supplying concise exact identities across frantic, contemplative and Detroit-framed directions. https://alexwilcox.bandcamp.com/album/rumpelstiltskin

Canonical admission still requires separate volume-fit, immediate-transition, three-to-five-track-run and long-form assessment. BPM is context only; perceived pulse, energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure and mixability remain UNKNOWN unless lawful evidence supplies them.
evidence.editorialInterpretation: Test the exact identity at the stated lawful boundaries without presuming sonic sameness, a seamless mix, a fixed chapter role or a mandatory downstream repair.
measured: Individual rhythm, direction and endpoint remain undocumented.
Exact BPM, endpoint, phrase fit and live mixability remain unknown unless stated above.
